question: For accounting purposes, the Initial Margin paid to the broker is treated as:
options: An Expense in the P&L Account
A Current Asset (Deposit) in the Balance Sheet
answer: A Current Asset (Deposit) in the Balance Sheet
explanation: Initial margin एक security deposit है, cost नहीं। यह client का asset रहता है जब तक कि इसका उपयोग losses को cover करने के लिए न किया जाए।

question: Under the Income Tax Act, 1961, trading in Interest Rate Derivatives on a recognized stock exchange is considered:
explanation: Section 43(5) recognized stock exchanges पर trade किए गए derivatives को 'speculative transactions' की definition से विशेष रूप से बाहर (exclude) करता है, उन्हें normal business income मानता है।

question: Is Securities Transaction Tax (STT) currently applicable to Exchange Traded Interest Rate Derivatives in India?
hint: सरकार bond market को बढ़ावा देना चाहती है।
explanation: Bond और interest rate derivative markets में participation को encourage करने के लिए, सरकार ने उन्हें STT से exempt (छूट) कर दिया है।

question: Daily Mark-to-Market (MTM) profits or losses should be recognized in the books of accounts:
options: Daily (or at the end of the reporting period)
answer: Daily (or at the end of the reporting period)
explanation: Accounting standards (जैसे AS-11/Ind AS 109) की आवश्यकता है कि MTM gains/losses को उस अवधि (period) के Statement of Profit and Loss में recognize किया जाए जिसमें वे होते हैं।

question: Brokerage and other transaction charges paid on IRD trades are treated as:
explanation: Brokerage, exchange charges, और अन्य fees ordinary business expenses हैं और business income से deductible (कटौती योग्य) हैं।

question: The 'Turnover' for the purpose of Tax Audit (Section 44AB) for derivative trading is calculated as:
options: Sum of absolute values of Profit and Loss
answer: Sum of absolute values of Profit and Loss
explanation: Tax audit limits के लिए, derivatives में turnover absolute profits और absolute losses का sum (योग) होता है (negative signs को ignore करते हुए)।

question: If an individual trades IRD as an investor (Capital Gains), short-term gains are taxed at:
options: Normal slab rates applicable to the individual
answer: Normal slab rates applicable to the individual
explanation: चूंकि STT pay नहीं किया जाता है, इसलिए gains को normal Short Term Capital Gains (यदि investment के रूप में hold किया गया है) माना जाता है और individual के slab rate पर tax लगाया जाता है।

question: GST (Goods and Services Tax) is applicable on:
explanation: GST (वर्तमान में 18%) broker द्वारा प्रदान की जाने वाली services (brokerage) और exchange charges पर लगाया जाता है, trade value या profit पर नहीं।

question: In the Balance Sheet, outstanding open positions in derivatives are typically disclosed as:
options: Contingent Liabilities (notes to accounts) or Financial Assets/Liabilities at Fair Value
answer: Contingent Liabilities (notes to accounts) or Financial Assets/Liabilities at Fair Value
explanation: Accounting standard (IGAAP बनाम Ind AS) के आधार पर, notional value अक्सर एक contingent liability होती है, जबकि MTM value को asset/liability के रूप में recognize किया जाता है।

question: Losses from 'Non-Speculative' derivative business can be set off against:
explanation: चूंकि इसे normal business loss माना जाता है, इसलिए इसे उसी वर्ष में अन्य business income या अन्य heads (Salary को छोड़कर) की income के against set off किया जा सकता है।

question: If a loss from derivative trading cannot be set off in the current year, it can be carried forward for:
explanation: Unabsorbed non-speculative business losses को भविष्य के business profits के against set off करने के लिए 8 assessment years तक carry forward किया जा सकता है।

question: Which accounting standard deals with 'Financial Instruments' (including derivatives) for Ind AS compliant companies?
hint: Financial instruments के लिए बड़ा standard।
explanation: Ind AS 109 financial instruments (derivatives सहित) के classification, measurement (Fair Value), और hedge accounting को cover करता है।

question: For a bank, trading in IRD is usually part of its:
hint: जहां वे पैसा manage करते हैं।
explanation: Banks अपने Treasury department के माध्यम से interest rate risk और proprietary trading को manage करते हैं।

question: When an option expires worthless, the premium paid is treated as:
explanation: Buyer के लिए, यदि option worthless expire हो जाता है, तो pay किया गया premium एक realized loss होता है।

question: When an option is exercised, the profit is:
explanation: Net profit, exercise पर प्राप्त intrinsic value में से option प्राप्त करने के लिए pay की गई cost (premium) को घटाकर आता है।

question: Hedge Accounting allows a firm to:
options: Match the timing of profit/loss recognition on the hedge with the underlying exposure
answer: Match the timing of profit/loss recognition on the hedge with the underlying exposure
explanation: Hedge accounting, derivative के gain/loss के recognition को hedge किए जा रहे item के gain/loss के साथ match करके P&L volatility को रोकता है।

question: If a transaction is treated as 'Speculative' (e.g., non-exchange traded without delivery), losses can be set off against:
hint: Speculative loss को अलग (quarantined) रखा जाता है।
explanation: Speculative transactions से होने वाले losses को केवल अन्य speculative transactions से होने वाले profits के against ही set off किया जा सकता है।

question: Stamp Duty on IRD is levied by:
hint: पूरे भारत में एक समान दर (Uniform rate)।
explanation: Amended Stamp Act के तहत, stamp duty पूरे भारत में एक समान दर (uniform rate) पर लगाई जाती है और Stock Exchange द्वारा collect की जाती है।

question: The 'Contract Note' serves as:
options: Primary evidence of the trade for accounting and tax purposes
answer: Primary evidence of the trade for accounting and tax purposes
explanation: Contract note broker द्वारा जारी किया गया legal document है जिसमें trade, price, taxes, और brokerage का विवरण होता है, जो bookkeeping के लिए आवश्यक है।

question: ICAI Guidance Note on Derivatives recommends that outstanding Futures contracts at balance sheet date should be valued at:
options: Lower of Cost or Market Value (Prudence)
answer: Lower of Cost or Market Value (Prudence)
explanation: Traditional guidance (non-Ind AS entities के लिए) अक्सर 'Lower of Cost or Market Value' या unrealized gains (Prudence) को ignore करते हुए anticipated losses के लिए provision बनाने का सुझाव देता है।

question: If a Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) trades in IRD, their income is typically characterized as:
explanation: Income Tax Act के अनुसार, FPIs द्वारा hold की गई securities को Capital Assets माना जाता है, इसलिए उनके transfer (derivatives सहित) से होने वाली income Capital Gains होती है।

question: Income Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on brokerage payments:
explanation: Corporate clients जो threshold limits से अधिक brokerage pay कर रहे हैं, उन्हें broker को payment करने से पहले TDS (आमतौर पर Sec 194H के तहत) deduct करना होगा।

question: Tax Audit is mandatory if business turnover exceeds:
options: Rs. 1 Crore (or higher limits like 10Cr if digital)
answer: Rs. 1 Crore (or higher limits like 10Cr if digital)
explanation: यदि turnover (absolute profit + absolute loss) prescribed limit (जैसे 1 Cr या 95% digital transactions के लिए 10 Cr) से अधिक है, तो tax audit आवश्यक है।

question: For calculating Capital Gains, the 'Cost of Acquisition' of a Future is:
explanation: Futures, differences के लिए contracts हैं। Asset को acquire करने के लिए कोई initial cost नहीं होती है, केवल transaction costs (brokerage आदि) होती हैं।

question: Which form is used to file Income Tax Returns for Business Income?
explanation: ITR-1 और ITR-2 salaried/other income के लिए हैं। Business income (trading सहित) के लिए ITR-3 या ITR-4 (presumptive) की आवश्यकता होती है।

question: Under 'Presumptive Taxation' (Section 44AD), a trader can declare:
explanation: Eligible assesses Section 44AD का option चुन सकते हैं और detailed books maintain करने से बचने के लिए turnover का 6% (digital transactions के लिए) profit के रूप में declare कर सकते हैं।

question: Accounting for 'Premium' received by an Option Writer (Seller):
options: Initially recorded as Liability, then adjusted on expiry/square-off
answer: Initially recorded as Liability, then adjusted on expiry/square-off
explanation: Received premium एक obligation (liability) है जब तक कि option expire या square off नहीं हो जाता, जिस point पर यह realized profit/loss बन जाता है।

question: Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax is generally:
options: Lower than Short Term Capital Gains tax
Higher than Short Term Capital Gains tax
answer: Lower than Short Term Capital Gains tax
explanation: Long-term investment को encourage करने के लिए LTCG rates आमतौर पर STCG की तुलना में lower (जैसे, 10% या 20%) होती हैं।

question: Can Expenses like internet charges, advisory fees, and books be claimed as deduction against Trading Business Income?
options: Yes, if they are wholly and exclusively for business purposes
answer: Yes, if they are wholly and exclusively for business purposes
explanation: IT Act के Section 37 के तहत पूरी तरह और विशेष रूप से (wholly and exclusively) business के purpose से किया गया कोई भी expenditure deductible है।

question: The 'Period of Holding' for derivatives to determine Short Term vs Long Term is usually:
options: Always Short Term (as they expire < 1 year)
answer: Always Short Term (as they expire < 1 year)
explanation: चूंकि derivative contracts की life आमतौर पर 1-3 महीने (most liquid cases में अधिकतम 1 वर्ष) होती है, इसलिए gains लगभग हमेशा Short Term होते हैं।

question: Penalty for not getting accounts audited (if mandatory) is:
options: 0.5% of turnover or Rs. 1.5 Lakhs, whichever is lower
answer: 0.5% of turnover or Rs. 1.5 Lakhs, whichever is lower
explanation: Tax audit report प्रस्तुत करने में विफलता Section 271B के तहत penalty को आकर्षित करती है।

question: IGST (Integrated GST) applies when:
options: The Broker and Client are in different states
The Broker and Client are in the same state
answer: The Broker and Client are in different states
explanation: यदि service provider (broker) और recipient (client) अलग-अलग राज्यों (states) में हैं, तो brokerage पर IGST लगाया जाता है।

question: CGST + SGST applies when:
options: The Broker and Client are in the same state
The Broker and Client are in different states
answer: The Broker and Client are in the same state
explanation: Intra-state (एक ही राज्य के भीतर) transactions के लिए, Central GST (CGST) और State GST (SGST) लगाया जाता है।

question: A 'Wash Sale' (selling and immediately buying back to book tax loss) is:
options: Allowed in India (no specific Wash Sale rule like US)
answer: Allowed in India (no specific Wash Sale rule like US)
explanation: हालांकि 'Tax Evasion' अवैध है, 'Tax Loss Harvesting' (actual losses बुक करना) भारत में legal है क्योंकि इसे disallow करने वाला कोई विशिष्ट 'Wash Sale' rule नहीं है, बशर्ते कि trade genuine हो।

question: Margin money paid in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR):
options: The interest on FDR belongs to the Client and is taxable
The interest belongs to the Broker
answer: The interest on FDR belongs to the Client and is taxable
explanation: FDR pledged (गिरवी) होता है, लेकिन ownership client के पास ही रहती है। Accrued interest client के लिए income है और taxable है।

question: Realized Profit on IRD trading is added to:
explanation: Profits tax computation के लिए assessee की Gross Total Income का हिस्सा होते हैं।

question: Effect of Section 43CA (Deeming provision) is generally:
explanation: Section 43CA land/building के undervaluation से संबंधित है, derivatives से नहीं।

question: If a corporate entity trades in IRD, the income is taxed at:
explanation: Companies अपनी business income पर लागू Corporate Tax Rate पर tax pay करती हैं, जिसमें trading profits शामिल हैं।

question: Which document is essential to prove the 'Date of Transaction' for tax purposes?
explanation: Contract Note में trade date होती है, जो यह निर्धारित (determine) करती है कि income/loss किस financial year में आता है।

question: The accounting entry for MTM Loss is:
options: Debit P&L Account, Credit Broker/Client Account
answer: Debit P&L Account, Credit Broker/Client Account
explanation: Loss एक expense है (Debit P&L), और यह broker के साथ balance को कम करता है या liability बढ़ाता है (Credit Broker)।

question: Under Ind AS, derivatives are measured at:
options: Fair Value Through Profit or Loss (FVTPL)
answer: Fair Value Through Profit or Loss (FVTPL)
hint: Market value P&L में जाता है।
explanation: Ind AS 109 की आवश्यकता है कि derivatives (जब तक कि वे effective hedges न हों) को mark to market किया जाए, और fair value में बदलाव P&L में जाए।

question: Provisions for 'Anticipated Losses' on open contracts are:
hint: Loss के लिए provision करें, profit को ignore करें।
explanation: Traditional accounting (Prudence) में वर्ष के अंत में open contracts पर foreseeable losses के लिए provision बनाना आवश्यक है।

question: If a trader has Business Loss from derivatives and Salary Income:
options: Business Loss CANNOT be set off against Salary Income
Business Loss can be set off against Salary
answer: Business Loss CANNOT be set off against Salary Income
explanation: Business losses को Salary को छोड़कर income के किसी भी अन्य head के against set off किया जा सकता है।

question: SEBI Turnover Fees are:
options: A regulatory fee collected by the exchange and passed to SEBI
answer: A regulatory fee collected by the exchange and passed to SEBI
explanation: यह SEBI की regulatory activities को fund करने के लिए turnover पर लगाया जाने वाला एक fee है।

question: Which ITR form is applicable for a person having only Presumptive Business Income?
explanation: ITR-4 उन individuals/HUFs/Firms (LLP को छोड़कर) के लिए simplified form है जो presumptive taxation (Sec 44AD/ADA) का विकल्प चुनते हैं।

question: Netting of margins across different exchanges is:
explanation: Interoperability एक ही Clearing Corporation के माध्यम से clear होने वाले exchanges के बीच margins को net करने की अनुमति देता है।

question: The 'Notional Value' of the contract is used for:
explanation: जबकि accounting MTM का उपयोग करती है, risk management और turnover calculations अक्सर Notional Value (Face Value * Quantity) का उपयोग करते हैं।

question: Income from 'Jobbing' or 'Arbitrage' in derivatives is treated as:
explanation: Jobbing और arbitrage जैसी regular trading activities एक business का गठन करती हैं, इसलिए उन्हें Business Income के रूप में tax लगाया जाता है।

question: Documentation Charges / Franking Charges are:
options: Expenses related to opening the account
answer: Expenses related to opening the account
explanation: ये legal documents (जैसे Member-Client Agreements) को execute करने के लिए one-time costs हैं।

question: In the case of a 'Loss' in derivative trading, filing an Income Tax Return is:
options: Necessary to carry forward the loss
answer: Necessary to carry forward the loss
hint: बाद में बचाने के लिए इसे रिपोर्ट करें।
explanation: Losses को future years में carry forward करने के benefit का claim करने के लिए, due date से पहले return file करना mandatory (अनिवार्य) है।
